chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Di king dey rejoice for your strength, Lord! How e dey rejoice well well for your salvation!
You don give am im heart desire and you no hold back di request of im lips. Selah.
Because you dey meet am with di blessings of goodness. You don put crown of fine gold on im head.
E ask you for life, and you give am, even long days forever and ever.
Im glory big for your salvation. You put honor and majesty on am.
Because you make am most blessed forever. You make am glad with joy for your presence.
Because di king dey trust di Lord. Through di faithful love of di Most High, nothing go move am.
Your hand go find all your enemies. Your right hand go find dem wey hate you.
You go make dem like burning furnace for di time of your anger. Di Lord go swallow dem for im fury. Di fire go eat dem.
You go destroy dem children from di earth and dem family from among di pikin dem of men.
Because dem plan evil against you. Dem plan wickedness against you, wey dem no fit finish.
Because you go make dem turn dem back, when you make your bowstrings ready against dem face.
Lord, make dem lift you up for your strength, so dat we go sing and praise your power.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. To di tune of Di Doe of di Morning. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: My God, my God, why you don leave me? Why you dey so far from helping me and from di words of my groaning?
My God, I dey cry for daytime, but you no dey answer, and for night, and I no dey quiet.
But you dey holy, you wey dey stay inside di praises of Israel.
Our papa dem trust you. Dem trust you, and you save dem.
Dem cry to you and dem save. Dem trust you, and dem no shame.
But I be worm and no be man, shame of men and di people dey despise me.
All dem wey see me dey mock me. Dem dey insult me with dem lips. Dem dey shake dem head and dey talk say,
“E trust di Lord, make e save am. Make e rescue am, since e enjoy am.”
But you bring me out of di womb. You make me trust you even for my mama breast.
Dem throw me on you from my mama womb. You be my God since my mama born me.
No dey far from me, because trouble near. Because nobody dey to help.
Plenty bulls don surround me. Strong bulls of Bashan don round me.
Dem dey open dem mouth wide against me, like lions wey dey tear prey and dey roar.
I pour out like water. All my bones don comot from joint. My heart be like wax. E don melt inside me.
My strength don dry like broken pot. My tongue dey stick to my jaws. You don bring me enter di dust of death.
Because dogs don surround me. Group of wrongdoers don enclose me. Dem don pierce my hands and my feet.
I fit count all my bones. Dem dey look and dey stare at me.
Dem dey share my clothes among dem. Dem dey cast lots for my cloth.
But no dey far, Lord. You be my help. Hurry to help me.
Save my soul from di sword, my precious life from di power of di dog.
Save me from di lion mouth! Yes, from di horns of di wild oxen you don answer me.
I go declare your name to my brothers. For di middle of di gathering I go praise you.
Una wey fear di Lord, praise am! All una Jacob family, give am glory! Fear am, all una Israel family!
Because e no despise or hate di suffering of di suffering person, and e no hide im face from am, but when e cry to am, e hear.
My praise of you dey come for di big gathering. I go pay my promises before dem wey fear am.
Di humble go eat and satisfy. Dem wey dey look for am go praise di Lord. Make your hearts live forever.
All di ends of di earth go remember and turn to di Lord. All di families of di nations go worship before you.
Because di kingdom na di Lord own. E be ruler over di nations.
All di rich ones of di earth go eat and worship. All dem wey dey go down to di dust go bow before am, even di one wey no fit keep im soul alive.
Future people go serve am. Dem go tell di coming generations about Lord.
Dem go come and declare im righteousness to people wey dem go born, because e don do am.
Di Lord na my shepherd. I no go lack anything.
E dey make me lie down for green grass. E dey lead me beside quiet waters.
E dey restore my soul. E dey guide me for di paths of righteousness for im name sake.
Even though I waka through di valley of di shadow of death, I no go fear evil, because you dey with me. Your rod and your staff, dem dey comfort me.
You dey prepare table before me for di presence of my enemies. You dey anoint my head with oil. My cup dey overflow.
Sure sure goodness and faithful love go follow me all di days of my life, and I go stay for di Lord house forever.
Di earth na di Lord own, with all wey dey inside am, di world and dem wey dey stay inside am.
Because e don found am on di seas and set am up on di floods.
Who fit go up to di hill of di Lord? Who fit stand for im holy place?
Di one wey get clean hands and pure heart, wey no lift im soul to lies and no swear with deceit.
E go receive blessing from di Lord, righteousness from di God of im salvation.
Dis na di generation of dem wey dey look for am, wey dey look for your face, even Jacob. Selah.
Lift up your heads, una gates! Make una dey lifted up, una everlasting doors, and di King of glory go enter.
Who be di King of glory? Di Lord strong and mighty, di Lord mighty for battle.
Lift up your heads, una gates, yes, lift dem up, una everlasting doors, and di King of glory go enter.
Who be dis King of glory? Di Lord of Armies na di King of glory! Selah.
To you, Lord, I lift up my soul.
My God, I don trust you. No let me shame. No let my enemies win over me.
Yes, nobody wey dey wait for you go shame. Dem go shame wey do wrong for no reason.
Show me your ways, Lord. Teach me your paths.
Guide me for your truth and teach me, because you be di God of my salvation. For you I dey wait all day.
Lord, remember your tender mercies and your faithful love, because dem don dey from long time.
No remember di sins of my youth or my wrongs. Remember me according to your faithful love, because of your goodness, Lord.
Di Lord dey good and honest, so e go teach sinners di way.
E go guide di humble for justice. E go teach di humble im way.
All di paths of di Lord na faithful love and truth to dem wey keep im covenant and im warnings.
For your name sake, Lord, forgive my wrong, because e big.
Which man dey fear di Lord? E go teach am di way wey e go choose.
Im soul go stay at ease. Im family go inherit di land.
Di friendship of di Lord dey with dem wey fear am. E go show dem im covenant.
My eyes dey always on di Lord, because e go pull my feet out of di net.
Turn to me and have mercy on me, because I dey alone and I dey suffer.
Di troubles of my heart don increase. Oh, bring me out of my troubles.
Look my suffering and my pain. Forgive all my sins.
Look my enemies, because dem plenty. Dem hate me with cruel hatred.
Oh, keep my soul and save me. No make me shame, because I run come you for protection.
Make honesty and uprightness keep me, because I dey wait for you.
Save Israel, God, from all im troubles.
Prove me right, Lord, because I don waka for my honesty. I don trust di Lord without shaking too.
Examine me, Lord, and test me. Try my heart and my mind.
Because your faithful love dey before my eyes. I don waka for your truth.
I no sit with deceitful men, and I no go enter with pretenders.
I hate di gathering of wrongdoers and I no go sit with di wicked.
I go wash my hands for innocence, so I go go round your altar, Lord,
so dat I go make di voice of thanksgiving hear and tell all your wonderful works.
Lord, I love di home of your house, di place where your glory dey stay.
No gather my soul with sinners or my life with men wey dey kill,
wey wickedness dey dem hands, and dem right hand full of bribes.
But as for me, I go waka for my honesty. Save me and show me mercy.
My foot dey stand for flat place. For di gatherings I go bless di Lord.
Di Lord na my light and my salvation. Who I go fear? Di Lord na di strength of my life. Who I go dey fear?
When wrongdoers come at me to eat my flesh, even my enemies and my foes, dem stumble and fall.
Even if army camp against me, my heart no go fear. Even if war rise against me, even den I go dey confident.
One thing I don ask di Lord, wey I go look for: make I stay for di Lord house all di days of my life, to see di beauty of di Lord and to ask for im temple.
Because for di day of trouble, e go keep me secretly for im tent. For di secret place of im tent, e go hide me. E go lift me up on rock.
Now my head go lift up above my enemies wey dey round me. I go offer sacrifices for im tent with shouts of joy. I go sing, yes, I go sing praises to di Lord.
Hear, Lord, when I cry loud. Show me mercy too and answer me.
When you talk say, “Look for my face,” my heart talk to you say, “I go look for your face, Lord.”
No hide your face from me. No put your servant away for anger. You don be my help. No leave me, and no abandon me, God of my salvation.
When my papa and my mama leave me, den di Lord go take me up.
Teach me your way, Lord. Lead me for straight path because of my enemies.
No give me to di desire of my enemies, because lying witnesses don rise against me, dem wey dey breathe out cruelty.
I still dey confident for dis: I go see di goodness of di Lord for di land of di living.
Wait for di Lord. Be strong, and make your heart take courage. Yes, wait for di Lord.
To you, Lord, I dey call. My rock, no deafen yourself to me, because if you quiet to me, I go be like dem wey dey go down to di pit.
Hear di voice of my begging, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
No drag me away with di wicked, with di wrongdoers wey dey talk peace with dem neighbors, but evil dey dem hearts.
Give dem according to dem work and according to di wickedness of wetin dem dey do. Give dem according to di work of dem hands. Bring back on dem wetin dem deserve.
Because dem no care for di works of di Lord or di work of im hands, e go break dem down and no go build dem up.
Blessed be di Lord, because e don hear di voice of my begging.
Di Lord na my strength and my shield. My heart don trust am, and e don help me. So my heart dey rejoice well well. With my song I go thank am.
Di Lord na dem strength. E be stronghold of salvation to im anointed.
Save your people and bless your inheritance. Be dem shepherd too and carry dem up forever.
Give di Lord, una sons of di mighty, give di Lord glory and strength.
Give di Lord di glory wey im name deserve. Worship di Lord for holy clothes.
Di voice of di Lord dey on di waters. Di God of glory dey thunder, even di Lord on plenty waters.
Di voice of di Lord dey powerful. Di voice of di Lord full of majesty.
Di voice of di Lord dey break di cedars. Yes, di Lord dey break di cedars of Lebanon to pieces.
E dey make dem jump like calf too, Lebanon and Sirion like young wild ox.
Di voice of di Lord dey strike with flashes of lightning.
Di voice of di Lord dey shake di wilderness. Di Lord dey shake di wilderness of Kadesh.
Di voice of di Lord dey make deer born and dey strip di forests bare. For im temple everything dey talk say, “Glory!”
Di Lord sit for im throne for di Flood. Yes, di Lord dey sit as King forever.
Di Lord go give strength to im people. Di Lord go bless im people with peace.

chapters.title: A Psalm. A song for di dedication of di temple. By David.

verses.text: I go lift you up, Lord, because you don raise me up and no let my enemies rejoice over me.
Lord my God, I cry to you, and you don heal me.
Lord, you don bring up my soul from Sheol. You don keep me alive, so dat I no go down to di pit.
Sing praise to di Lord, una wey be im holy ones. Give thanks to im holy name.
Because im anger na only for one moment. Im favor na for whole life. Crying fit stay for night, but joy dey come for morning.
As for me, I talk for my good fortune say, “Nothing go ever move me.”
You, Lord, when you favor me, make my mountain stand strong, but when you hide your face, I dey troubled.
I cry to you, Lord. I beg Lord.
“Wetin I go gain if dem destroy me, if I go down to di pit? Di dust go praise you? E go declare your truth?
Hear, Lord, and have mercy on me. Lord, be my helper.”
You don turn my mourning to dancing for me. You don remove my sackcloth and cover me with gladness,
so dat my heart go sing praise to you and no go keep quiet. Lord my God, I go thank you forever!
